observations: Front-loading washer-dryer unit, silver/grey finish, branded 'LG' on top-left of control panel (photo 0).
Text on panel reads 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg' and a red badge reads 'Washer+Dryer 2 in 1' (photo 0).
Control dial appears lit with orange indicator lights and a small digital display shows digits (photo 0), suggesting the unit has power/electronics active at the time of the photo.
Door glass is intact, some reddish fabric visible inside drum.
Unit sits on tiled floor next to a wall with visible paint damage/mold; drainage/power cords visible hanging loose.
No visible external damage to the cabinet, no dents, no rust streaks seen on the front panel.
A small panel near bottom right appears ajar/open (possible filter or pump access door).

claims.claim: Washing machine is scrap / doesn't work / needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the control panel display lit and dial indicator lights glowing, which could indicate partial power/electronic function, but no spin or wash cycle is shown running, so the extent of the fault cannot be confirmed from a still photo.

risks.risk: Motor/drum does not spin or agitate even though panel appears powered
risks.proof: Short video of a power-on cycle attempt showing drum movement or lack thereof

risks.risk: Water leakage from hoses, pump, or door seal
risks.proof: Photo/video of rear hose connections and door seal gasket condition, plus a water-fill test

risks.risk: Internal rust, mold, or drum bearing wear not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of drum interior close-up and a bearing-wobble test video

risks.risk: Missing accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable) needed for reinstallation
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Control board or display fault despite lights showing (could be an error-code loop, not real operation)
risks.proof: Video of pressing power/start and observing full cycle attempt

proof_requests: Video of the unit being powered on and an attempt to start a wash cycle (showing drum motion or error behavior)
Close-up photo of the door seal/gasket for tears or mold
Photo of the rear panel showing hose and power cable connections
Photo of the drum interior for rust or damage
Confirmation photo of all accessories (hoses, cable) included in sale
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer combo from the visible branding and text in photo 0, and though the seller's 'doesn't work' claim is unverified, the worst-case non-functional condition can still be priced as scrap/for-repair without needing further proof to assign a floor price.
